items.title: KFC Reveals the Oreo Chicken Burger, and We're Both Revolted and Intrigued
items.summary: Has capitalism gone too far? KFC China has just revealed the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger, and we can't

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/oreo-kfc-chicken-burger-cookie-1787672806516.jpg

If you're a fan of strange and unholy fast food concoctions, then you'll definitely want to see what the crazed scienticians at KFC and Nabisco have concocted. Fresh off the reveal of their fried chicken-flavored Oreo cookies in China, the two companies have reversed that fusion to create the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger.

This bizarre collab was revealed by KFC China on Weibo ( via Dexerto ). It looks every bit as strange as it sounds. The sandwich starts off ordinarily enough, with a fried chicken patty and lettuce, but it's topped with brown mashed potatoes dusted in cookie crumbles and placed between two Oreo cookie-flavored buns.

Like any good fast food mash-up, we can't decide if we're grossed out by this creation or deeply intrigued. Either way, American foodies shouldn't count on being able to try the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger anytime soon. The sandwich is currently limited to the Chinese market only, with no indication of when or if it might come to the US.
Will you devour an Oreo Chicken Sandwich if given the opportunity? Cast your vote in our poll below:

This is just the latest odd creation from the folks at Nabisco. Past Oreo cookie variants have included Post Malone Oreos , which featured swirled salted caramel and shortbread flavored cream squeezed between one golden and one chocolate Oreo wafer cookie, and Mario Oreos . And in perhaps the most unholy combination of them all, there's the Ritz Oreo .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

items.title: DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction is a definite improvement but path traced fidelity is still not a 100% solved issue
items.summary: Nvidia has rounded out the DLSS 4.5 stack… now where's DLSS 5?

content.v: Nvidia's new DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction feature is laser-focused on trying to fix the second most annoying thing about ray traced or path traced games: visual artifacting. Yes, the lighting effect does deliver the most accurate-looking lighting and shadows in games, but in motion there is a definite visual weirdness added into scenes. And that weirdness generally comes from the denoising pass designed to turn the low-fidelity path traced image, with its limited number of rays, into a fully realised frame.

Leave a game's viewport still and the scene will pretty rapidly come together to make a sharp, convincing image. Shift that around, or have that scene filled with moving objects or characters and you're going to see the sort of visual trails you might only have been used to in the warehouse parties of your early twenties. Just me?

The issue is that it's way too expensive in terms of raw compute to trace every single photon/pixel that would otherwise make up a fully traced scene. Even with the current method of tracking a far smaller representative sample of rays bouncing around the geometry of your game world it's still incredibly demanding of your PC's hardware.

This is, by the way, the most annoying thing about ray traced or path traced games: the amount of graphical horsepower the tech demands over pre-baked lighting techniques. The huge performance hit it involves is punitive for all but the most powerful GPUs, and we are still no closer to solving that right now.
So we still have to use small numbers of tracked rays to create an approximate scene which looks something like this:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uY4idmEU2JUwziqKXwug6R.jpg

But that doesn't look great if you're trying to make a convincing world, though I guess there's something to that aesthetic in a sort of 3D ASCII kind of way . Anyway, to realise this image into a production ready frame you need to use a denoiser to fill in the blanks between the sampled rays, and the hand-tuned denoisers track and group pixels across multiple frames, to give them access to more samples. They then use these neighbouring pixels to interpolate and blend the scene together.

As I said, that's fine for a static image, but those pixels don't stay representative for long and in motion they break down, adding in artifacting to a scene and smearing detail away from textures. This is where the original Ray Reconstruction feature came in, replacing the hand-tuned denoisers with an AI-based denoiser working alongside Nvidia's upscaling models, to generate more accurate pixels in between those sampled rays.
And now we're finally getting an updated version of Ray Reconstruction which uses the sharper second-gen Transformer model initially brought into DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution back in January .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hYUBSUSfmKQrJHuPj933fD.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/daAr32D8JPgndUyYbq4SdD.jpg

And it's about time, because for ray or path traced games, even if you were using the improved transformer model of DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction was still using the old model, leaving you those tell-tale artifacts.
Nvidia is touting four main improvements with DLSS 4.5 RR:

The new version of the feature is releasing today, and jamming the second-gen transformer model into supported games is done via the Nvidia App rather than from inside your games' settings screens. You just need to select a title from within the Nvidia App itself, navigate to the 'DLSS Override - Model Presets' entry and select 'Preset F' from the 'Ray Reconstruction' dropdown menu . Apply it and you should be set.
Alan Wake 2
EVERSPACE 2
NTE (Neverness to Everness)
Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora
Portal with RTX
Backrooms: Escape Together
FBC: Firebreak
PRAGMATA
Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 (Coming August 20th)
Half-Life 2 RTX
Resident Evil Requiem
Crimson Desert
Hogwarts Legacy
Samson
Cyberpunk 2077
I Am Jesus Christ
Star Wars Outlaws
Death Relives

Subliminal
Directive 8020
Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
Sword of Justice
DOOM: The Dark Ages
Marvel’s Spider-Man 2
The First Descendant
Enlisted
NARAKA: BLADEPOINT
War Thunder

While complete image fidelity across all ray or path traced games is by no means a 100% solved problem, it's clear that DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction is able to deliver a more stable image when it's in use. And it's not just about giving you a more stable image with less 'boiling' textures and trails, either, it's adding back in more detail to a scene that would have otherwise been lost.

You can see that especially in the below video for Resident Evil Requiem's opening scene. The textures on the white car at the beginning are still shimmering behind the rain effects using the older model, but are almost entirely stable with DLSS 4.5 RR enabled. But it's the extra detail on the ground that highlights what the new second-gen transformer model is capable of here.

Of course we're going to highlight what it looks like in Nvidia's poster child for all things DLSS: Cyberpunk 2077. In the two videos below you can see where that extra temporal stability really makes a difference. In this first video, inside a store, you can see the striping on the ground as the viewport shifts, which is completely absent from the improved DLSS 4.5 RR version.

You might have to watch it loop through a couple of times to see what I mean, but if you focus on the older version on the right you will see, when the view moves to the floor, that there is an after image of essentially the edge of the screen imprinted on the floor. This fades quickly, but is noticeable.

Outside, looking up at the ceiling of this underpass you can see where the textures resolve far, far quicker than before. The different areas of the ceiling using the previous version of RR almost seem like they can't make up their mind what they should look like, while DLSS 4.5 RR comes in with far more certainty.

My final example comes from Alan Wake 2 and its own heavy use of path tracing and the denoising steps that are vital to the game's fidelity. To be honest, the strange artifcating of Alan Wake 2 almost gets a pass from me, because the dreamlike trails around people kinda add to the weirdness of the game. But it's not meant to look like that.

You can see from the dancing man in the Elderwood Palace Lodge bar that those trails are almost entirely gone from the latest version of Ray Reconstruction. But, notably, they are not completely resolved. There is still some level of artifacting around his feet as he shuffles around the wooden floor.

Though it is worth noting here you can also see the enhanced level of detail the second-gen transformer is adding back in. If you look to the wooden floor in the room behind the dancing dude you will see the planks are more clearly represented.

So yes, there is still some work to be done before we can say that path tracing visuals have been perfected, but this is still a worthy upgrade. And honestly, we probably need a mixture of both improved AI modelling and more powerful hardware to be able to add more traced light bounces into a frame. But in these tech-starved times of ours, hoping for more horsepower when the datacentres want to jealously hoard all the compute for themselves is a fool's game.

items.title: PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for September 2026 Leak, Headlined by Sniper Elite: Resistance
items.summary: September's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has leaked online ahead of Sony's official announcement.

others.title: PS Plus Essential Games for September 2026 Leaked Early

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2022/11/26/chainedechoesthumb-1669479023042.jpg
September's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has leaked online ahead of Sony's official announcement.

As detailed by Dealabs ' ever-reliable billbilk-kun, next month's list of titles available to PlayStation Plus subscribers will include last year's Sniper Elite: Resistance, placing you behind the long gun barrel of a British agent infiltrating Nazi-occupied Europe in 1944.

"A solid stealth-based shooter," is how IGN's Sniper Elite: Resistance review described the game, affording it a 6/10 score. "It fails to set its sights high enough in order to pull off a truly spectacular execution," we added.

Released back in 2022, the classic Japanese role-playing game inspired Chained Echoes is next on the roster. Inspired by classics such as Secret of Mana, Chrono Trigger and Final Fantasy 4, this retro-feeling RPG proudly wears its influences on its sleeve — but is no worse off for doing so.

Lastly, there's Wobbly Life. This colorful open-world sandbox launched last year and lets you muck about with friends to complete jobs, earn money, and own houses. All three games will be available from September 1 to October 6.
As a reminder, you still have until September 1 to claim August's trio of titles for PS Plus members. Those offerings include Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Reloaded Edition, Big Walk and Signalis.

items.title: The Lord Of The Rings Extended Trilogy Is Massively Discounted Just After Surprise Game Re-Release
items.summary: If the recent re-release of The Lord of the Rings: War in the North got you excited about the fantasy franchis

content.v: If the recent re-release of The Lord of the Rings: War in the North got you excited about the fantasy franchise and looking for more, Amazon currently has a great deal going for the Peter Jackson movies.
The retailer is selling a digital copy of the three-movie extended-edition bundle for just $15 . It normally goes for $45, so this is quite a deal, at least if you're OK owning the movies digitally.

2026 is the 25th anniversary of the films, as The Fellowship of the Ring debuted in 2001. The sequels The Two Towers and The Return of the King followed in 2002 and 2003, respectively. They were all big hits critically and commercially.

Return of the King, for its part, swept at the Oscars in 2004, winning all 11 of the awards it was nominated for, including Best Picture and Best Director for Jackson. There are more The Lord of the Rings movies now in the works, including The Hunt for Gollum in 2027.

As for the game series, recent entries like The Lord of the Rings: Gollum and Tales of the Shire left a lot to be desired. There are new games now in the works, including a "deeply immersive" game from Kingdom Come studio Warhorse . Additionally, Tomb Raider studio Crystal Dynamics is said to be working on its own The Lord of the Rings game . There will also be more re-releases of "classic" The Lord of the Rings games coming up.

items.title: Latest GTA 6 Leak References Irony Of The Game Being A Digital-Exclusive
items.summary: Yet another alleged GTA 6 leak has emerged, showing off one of the game's main characters, Jason, visiting a v

content.v: Yet another alleged GTA 6 leak has emerged, showing off one of the game's main characters, Jason, visiting a video game store that sells physical discs. This has prompted people to point out the irony of GTA 6 being a digital-exclusive game.
In the clip, we see Jason visit a store called Game Horde where he uses binoculars to zoom in on the shelves, showing various games and consoles.
"This is not about actual discs. It's about ownership. Resale rights still matter, even in a digital-only era," reads a watermark on the video.

GTA 6 will be sold at brick-and-mortar retailers, but the game's physical edition only includes a code in the box. The data shows that more and more people, on a percentage basis, are buying games digitally today. But a lot of people still want physical game discs, while many have also expressed concerns about game preservation concerns in a digital-only era.
When the GTA 6 leaks began, the person claiming responsibility listed off various "commandments," including the following:
For more, check out GameSpot's timeline of the GTA 6 leaks so far .
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The gameplay leaks have been extensive, but they don't matter and people should calm down , a former Rockstar director has said.
Rockstar and Take-Two have yet to identify the person or people responsible for the leak. Whoever they may be, they appear to have access to the game.

In 2022, GTA 6 suffered its first major leak of gameplay footage. The autistic 18-year-old suspect was apprehended and ordered to live in a secure hospital for life . In July this year, it was reported that the person, Arion Kurtaj, left the secure hospital and is now in a “normal prison” awaiting a new trial.
While the leaks have shown a lot of new footage and revealed new insights about GTA 6, we're now just days away from Rockstar releasing official footage of the game on Netflix on August 27 .

items.title: Hideo Kojima wants to 'continue to focus on making games' at 63, even as 'the time I have decreases'
items.summary: "I need to constantly scrutinize how I use my time and how I live my life."

content.v: It's often said that time comes for us all—and while it may not yet be at the doorstep of one Hideo Kojima, he's grown introspective about the prospect on social media after turning 63 over the weekend. In case you've somehow not heard of the man, he's the mind behind the Metal Gear series and Death Stranding.

"I've turned 63," Kojima posted to X . "As I get older, the things I 'have to do' and the things I 'want to do' keep increasing. On the other hand, the 'time I have' decreases. I need to constantly scrutinize how I use my time and how I live my life."

It's a particularly nostalgic date for Kojima, however, as 2026 also "marks the 40th anniversary of when I started making games, and the 10th anniversary of Kojima Productions." To celebrate, he intends to hold an exhibition at Tokyo's Azabudai Hills Gallery starting at the end of October and lasting until the end of the year.

To those fearing his flooded schedule and nostalgic thoughts might precede a retirement from games, though, rest easy. Kojima's flooded schedule is more of a motivator than a detractor: "With all the opportunities and offers I'm receiving, I want to continue to focus on making games. Thank you for your continued support."

Which, hey, is a relief even as someone not particularly attached to either of his flagship franchises—not for purposes of taste, mind. With an industry where big-budget games are coming out with increasingly bland, characterless stories , I'm charmed pink whenever I see some out-of-context Death Stranding cutscene where Tommie Earl Jenkins breaks out into song, or Troy Baker plays guitar while dressed up like a cyberpunk Joker.
It's hard to imagine an industry without Kojima, though it'll happen someday. At which point he'll apparently be watching movie trailers .

items.title: The Asus ROG Xbox Ally X20 Costs $1,300, And The OLED Screen Better Be Worth It
items.summary: Almost a year after launch, the Asus Xbox ROG Ally is getting an upgrade--and a hefty price increase--in the f

content.v: Almost a year after launch, the Asus Xbox ROG Ally is getting an upgrade--and a hefty price increase--in the form of the X20 model. Revealed earlier this year as part of a bundle sold with a set of XR glasses, Asus has opened preorders for the handheld gaming PC, with prices starting at an eye-watering $1,300 from the official Asus online store and Best Buy .

What does an extra $300 get you? The biggest draw is the screen, as Asus has equipped this model with a 7.4‑inch 1080p OLED 120Hz HDR display. The shell is also constructed from translucent plastic so you can see the inner workings of the ROG Ally X20, and those internals include an 80Wh battery, 1TB of storage capacity, 24GB of DDR5 RAM, and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity. The X20 also features a redesigned layout meant to improve airflow and thermal efficiency, as these units can get hot while running demanding games.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-11.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-10.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-2.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-3.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-4.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-5.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-6.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-7.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-8.jpg
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Asus-XS20-9.jpg

Asus added that it has improved the D-pad and installed TMR magnetic induction analog sticks. The unit still runs on the AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme processor, which is capable of handling modern games smoothly. If you've got $2,500 to spare, you can also grab a bundle deal that includes the ROG Ally X20, a pair of 240Hz ROG XReal X1 glasses, a Dbrand Killswitch protective case set, and a Pelican case to store everything in.

That's a lot of dough for a handheld, but it's not too surprising. The global shortage of memory driven by AI has seen component prices skyrocket, and several manufacturers of handheld gaming PCs have had to adjust their prices. Earlier this year, AyaNeo suspended preorders and early-bird sales of its Next 2 handheld in response to rapidly rising costs, while console prices are also feeling the pinch . The silver lining is that the makers of retro handhelds are filling the gap for affordable gaming on the go, and these cheap units make more sense than ever in 2026.

Pricing for the $1,000 Xbox ROG Ally X and its smaller-specced $600 sibling hasn't increased ( yet ), and both machines are a pretty great option for playing PC and Xbox games on the go--if you can afford them. While both devices did have some teething issues with their software, recent updates have smoothed out these problems, and the Xbox app works well as a platform for users to launch games from Microsoft's store, Steam, and more.

items.title: Why GTA Games Are A “Stab In The Heart,” But Also Amazing, For Ex-Dishonored Dev
items.summary: According to industry veteran Raphaël Colantonio, who worked on the Dishonored series at Arkane before startin

content.v: According to industry veteran Raphaël Colantonio, who worked on the Dishonored series at Arkane before starting his own studio, GTA games are "the biggest tease" and also "the biggest disappointment" for people who love immersive sim games.

"I don't mean that in an offensive way because of course who am I and who are they? They make games that sell I don't know how many thousands times more than mine and they are so incredible at doing surface simulation," he told Press Box PR . "But that’s such a stab in the heart for me when they don’t go more than surface level where there’s no long-term consequences to anything you do."
GTA games, instead, offer more of a "fantastic sandbox with incredible execution, incredible cinematography, [and] great gameplay," Colantonio added.

He went on to say Rockstar has a formula and that he "understands why they do it." At the same time, Colantonio said a game like Skyrim is more to his liking. He said in Skyrim, there is "just one instance of the world," so your actions have real, meaningful, and lasting consequences.
"You really own your consequences as a player. Everything is playable and you have to deal with your choices for the rest of the game," he said.

Colantonio was speaking about GTA games so far, and not specifically GTA 6. Rockstar has yet to share specifics on how it might have updated the formula for the new game, or if there might be further reactivity to choices players make.

He theorized that Rockstar's belief with the GTA series is that offering too much in the way of choices having real, lasting consequences confuses the player too much, so the developers take a different approach.

"What Rockstar basically say is, you know what? That part sucks. It’s too hard to do. It confuses players and most players won’t care at all anyway," he said. "Here’s what we will do instead. We put a guy with a question mark on their head. They have a mission for you. When you want to play the mission, we open an instance of the world in which nothing else matters than what's inside this instance. Then, because of that there is a trade off."

This setup works well for GTA games, Colantonio said, because it affords Rockstar the ability to have incredible set pieces and action sequences. But, again, that's not something he's personally interested in.

"People are going to be thrilled but none of it matters. That's the thing. We don't have to deal with the consequences. The players don't have to deal with the consequences. Therefore, we can push the buttons, crank things up to 11, and I totally get the draw," he said. "I totally understand why people are into it. I understand why they would be into it as developers. I understand why it sells so much but this is not my values, not that my values are not to sell a gazillion units!"
He went on to say that GTA games allowing players to fail missions and try them again breaks immersion.

"If you fail the mission, you find yourself back out on the street and there’s the same guy with the same question mark over his head who you click on and you’re ready to restart the mission. There’s nothing immersive to me in that," he explained.

Again, Colantonio said he makes these remarks "with the greatest respect" for Rockstar and what they do. "They do things that are amazing," he said, adding that he expects to get flamed for what he's saying about Rockstar and GTA.
"But no, I respect them a lot. It's just that it's not my bike," he said.
Asked what he would think of Rockstar making GTA 7 an immersive sim kind of game, Colantonio joked that Rockstar should do it if they want to sell fewer copies.

"It's highly respectable. It's great in so many ways. It's just not my thing, and I couldn't imagine a world where they would want me in there because I'm going to bring some bizarre stuff. They're going for more direct paraphernalia where instantly you know the gameplay. It doesn't need digestion and there isn’t anything obscure like what we do here, so yeah it's a difference like the difference between Steven Spielberg and David Lynch or whatever," he said. "One is going to sell gazillions and the other one is going to be a little more indirect and obscure and sometimes land a hit."

Colantonio ended his thoughts by saying he is "really, really looking forward" to GTA 6 because he wants to see "how far they can push the instant simulation, surface simulation, because they do all that so incredibly well, and it's inspiring, and I love that."

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game has seen numerous gameplay leaks this month, and Rockstar and Take-Two are said to be hunting down the people or parties responsible . Whatever happens, Rockstar is sticking with its plans to show the game off, in an official capacity, on August 27 via an extended trailer on Netflix.
As for Colantonio, he now heads up WolfEye Studios, which launched its first game, Weird West, in 2022. WolfEye is now working on a new game that hasn't been announced yet.

items.title: Nintendo Announces First Switch 2 Bundles to Launch Following the Console's September Price Hike
items.summary: Nintendo has revealed its first Switch 2 console bundles for launch following the console's upcoming price ris

others.title: Nintendo Reveals A New Switch 2 Bundle, Launching This October

content.v: Nintendo has revealed its first Switch 2 console bundles for launch following the console's upcoming price rise. Two options will be available, offering discounts on purchasing the platform with either Mario Kart World or Nintendo Switch Sports Resort .

As a reminder, Switch 2 is set to increase in price within the U.S., Canada, U.K. and mainland Europe in just five days' time, meaning you have a limited window in which to still buy one for its launch price. In the U.S., Switch 2 will rise by $50, to $499.99.

From "late September", Nintendo will once again bundle Switch 2 with its launch title Mario Kart World and three months of Nintendo Switch Online membership. This package will sell for $549.99, which Nintendo says is a $37.98 saving.

Next, from October 22, a second bundle option will become available alongside the launch of Nintendo Switch Sports Resort. The game and console, plus a 90-day Nintendo Switch Online subscription, will sell for $529.99. This is a saving of $27.98, Nintendo says.

While new options for prospective Switch 2 owners to save money is a welcome move, it's worth emphasizing that you'll save even more money if you are able to buy a console and Mario Kart World in the next few days.

On top of all that, those on the lookout for a snazzier console design might be tempted by the leaked images of a The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Nintendo Switch 2 console and Pro Controller that popped up online earlier this month. However, there's no telling yet how much these might cost. It's likely we'll see these made official soon, ahead of Nintendo's Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake arriving before the end of the year.

Nintendo first confirmed it would raise Switch 2 prices back in May, ensuring that customers had several months of warning before the cost increases took effect. At the time, the company apologized for the need to raise prices and blamed the changes on "market conditions" and stated it had been forced to consider "the global business outlook."

The Switch 2's price rise is, of course, just the latest example of a hardware manufacturer increasing prices. PlayStation, Xbox and Valve have all upped prices over the past year, in the face of global uncertainty around shipping, tariffs, and ballooning component prices. So, is now the right time to for you to jump in on Switch 2?

Here’s an unexpected crossover: Pokémon and Polaroid have teamed up to release a trio of pocket monster-themed instant cameras. There’s a yellow one based on Pikachu, complete with a lightning bolt tale; a pink-and-white Sylveon one with a ribbon-like strap; and a red-and-white one meant to evoke a Pokéball. They look great, but they're selling out fast. You can check stock on Amazon , Pokémon Center , and Polaroid . If you see the one you want available, you'll want to order it fast.
Pokémon X Polaroid Instant Cameras and Film

These are all Polaroid Now Generation 3 I-Type Instant Film Cameras, which means they're chunky and colorful, and they shoot full-size Polaroid pictures. The prints come out of the camera right after you take the photo. Polaroid also touts this model's "optimized exposures for sharper pictures."

The Sylveon-themed film has a pink border with purple Sylveon and Pokéball silhouettes. Pikachu film has a yellow boarder, with three little Pikachus along the thick bottom side. Finally, the standard Pokémon Edition film has multiple designs, each one based on a popular Pokémon.
Again, if you're interested in picking up any of these items, you'll want to do it sooner than later. They seem to be quite popular and won't likely stay in stock for long.

items.title: The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay Remains One of the Most Underrated Games Ever
items.summary: The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay didn’t just break the licensed-game curse, it was a bona fi

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260825/omzjTKbuaCxiqjq.jpg
这是一篇来自 Ryan McCaffrey 的评论文章，他曾在 2002 年至 2012 年初代 Xbox 和 Xbox 360 时代任职于《官方 Xbox 杂志》（Official Xbox Magazine），后来成为资深的“Xbox 专家”。在 Xbox 25 周年即将到来之际，他将分享他在该平台第一个四分之一世纪里的回忆。

当我在《官方 Xbox 杂志》工作时，进入办公室区域首先映入眼帘的就是我们的演示站。那里放着一张小沙发和我们最大的电视——一台 36 英寸的 CRT 巨兽，可以显示 480p 画面。这意味着它的分辨率虽然与其他主机游戏相同，但没有隔行扫描，因此图像更加清晰。因为当开发人员来向我们展示他们正在开发的游戏时，我们希望它们看起来处于最佳状态。我从未对那台巨大的 480p 电视如此心存感激，直到一家当时名不见经传（至少对我而言）的瑞典开发商 Starbreeze 带着他们正在制作的授权游戏前来展示：The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay。
“管他呢，”我想，“这肯定又是个廉价的电影圈钱货。”然后我亲眼看到了它，惊讶得合不拢嘴。

有趣的是，第一件让我瞪大眼睛的事甚至不是游戏本身——虽然几分钟后也发生了。不，我和 OXM 团队的其他成员都被 Riddick 的前端菜单界面迷住了。看，那是一个法线贴图的 3D 立方体，当你从一个选项移动到下一个选项时，字母会从那个闪亮的、纹理精美的立方体中弹出或缩回。法线贴图在当时是一种新的图形技术；我们以前在主机上从未真正见过它。但 Xbox 完全有能力胜任，除了 Riddick 之外，主机上的其他游戏也开始充分利用这一技术。
回到 Riddick。Starbreeze 团队向我们展示了一款第一人称越狱游戏，拥有疯狂的光照效果、与无数 NPC 进行的类 RPG 对话、围绕主角“眼部闪光”（让他能在黑暗中视物）建立的绝佳阴影潜行系统、一些恐怖元素，以及相当不错的第一人称射击内容。当我们在 2004 年 6 月发布前拿到完整游戏时，他们成功地制作出了整款如此优秀的游戏。它拥有画面、音频、氛围、故事和玩法。它拥有一切。
Riddick 不仅仅打破了授权游戏的魔咒，它还是当年 Xbox 年度游戏的真正竞争者。

Riddick 不仅仅打破了授权游戏的魔咒，它还是当年 Xbox 年度游戏的真正竞争者（那年的胜者是 11 月发行的那款名为 Halo 2 的小游戏）。如果你在想，“等等，什么授权游戏魔咒？”对于年轻读者来说，基于授权 IP 改编的电子游戏几乎普遍被认为是糟糕透顶的圈钱之作。这并不是因为游戏开发者的努力不够。相反，是游戏发行商认为他们可以投入尽可能少的钱——无论是人才、开发周期还是两者兼而有之——这都无关紧要，因为人们无论如何都会因为包装盒正面印着的授权 IP 而购买游戏。我想他们在某种程度上一定是正确的，因为多年来，好的（更不用说伟大的）授权游戏是例外，而不是常态。
Riddick 是那道大坝上的第一道裂缝，此后大坝彻底崩塌（另见：蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆疯人院）。当然，并不是说现在的每一款授权游戏都很优秀，但像 Riddick 和 蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆疯人院 这样的游戏终于向发行商证明，如果他们投资顶尖人才并给予充足的资源，他们能赚到的钱远比仅仅追求廉价的圈钱之作要多得多。

此外，Vin Diesel 本人也值得称赞，尽管 Starbreeze 功不可没。Diesel 曾是（想必现在也是）一名资深玩家，他通过协助开发 Escape from Butcher Bay 的 Tigon Studios 开发团队在项目中发挥了积极作用。Diesel 不希望他扮演的角色出现在一款烂游戏里，就像玩家不希望看到的一样。通过与当时相对默默无闻的 Starbreeze 合作，他帮助确保了 Richard B. Riddick 不会遭受许多其他从大银幕转型到游戏主机屏幕的角色所面临的悲惨命运。
尽管 Escape from Butcher Bay 非常出色，但可以说它仍被严重低估了。如果你从未有机会玩过它，现在还不算太晚。当然，在 2026 年，它的画面不会让你感到惊艳（甚至不会给你留下深刻印象），但它的玩法依然经得起推敲。

items.title: New Mario Kart World Switch 2 Bundle Coming In September, And It’s $50 More Expensive Than The Original
items.summary: Ahead of the Switch 2's price hike in September, Nintendo has announced two new Switch 2 bundles for the US. T

content.v: Ahead of the Switch 2's price hike in September, Nintendo has announced two new Switch 2 bundles for the US.
The Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle ($550) launches in late September, while the Switch 2 + Nintendo Switch Sports bundle ($530) arrives alongside the game on October 22.

People may recall that Nintendo offered a Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle when the console launched in June 2025. It was priced at $500 back then, but was subsequently discontinued. Comparisons to the new bundle are not entirely 1:1, however, as the original 2025 bundle did not include a Switch Online membership.

Due to various economic pressures, Nintendo is raising the price of the Switch 2 by $50 on September 1 , bringing it up to $500. That new price is factored in to the new bundle price, which is why it's $550.

The new Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle comes with a Switch 2, a code for the digital version of Mario Kart World, and a 3-month Nintendo Switch Online individual membership. Nintendo says the $550 price point represents a savings of $38 compared to buying each item individually, but that's not the whole story.

Currently, the Switch 2 costs $450 and Mario Kart World is $80, so that works out to $530 together. You can get three months of Switch Online for $8 on Amazon , for a grand total of $538, so you can save money (about $12 before tax) by purchasing everything now as opposed to waiting for this new bundle to release.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-25-at-9.10.10-AM-1.png?w=636

The Nintendo Switch 2 + Nintendo Switch Sports Resort bundle, meanwhile, includes a Switch 2 system, a code for a digital copy of Nintendo Switch Sports Resort, and a 3-month Nintendo Switch Online individual membership. Purchasing these items separately would cost you $28 more, Nintendo said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-25-at-9.10.22-AM.png?w=636
Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is the newest entry in the series, featuring 12 sports at launch, including wacky new ones like thumb wrestling.

手柄原生适配，还原游戏操作体验
海量大作，热门新游无需下载，即刻游玩

与大多数尝试在本地运行游戏的Windows游戏掌机不同，联想C700是围绕云游戏和串流技术打造，联想表示，这使其比市面上典型的掌机更轻薄。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787663139_563698.jpg

content.v: 此前我们曾报道，有网友发现，天猫PlayStation官方旗舰店、京东PlayStation自营旗舰店以及索尼官方旗舰店等官方销售渠道中，PS5 Pro主机目前均已显示下架，无法正常购买。相比之下，标准版PS5仍在各大店铺正常销售，商品页面也未受到影响。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252107562871.jpg
近日，国行PS5 Pro在官方渠道重新上架后迅速被抢购一空。目前京东PlayStation自营旗舰店等平台均已显示无货，无法正常购买。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252108049883.png
本次恰逢开学季促销活动，商品页面标注活动周期从8月20日持续至9月25日，不过上架后库存快速被抢购一空，页面直接变为无货状态，仅保留到货通知入口。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252108126140.jpg
截至发稿，索尼方面尚未公布PS5 Pro大规模缺货的具体原因，机器的高价依旧挡不住玩家的抢购热情，想要现货的玩家只能等待下一轮补货。

items.title: 苹果首个2nm芯片来了！全新Mac mini售价6999元起
items.summary: 苹果首个2nm芯片来了！全新Mac mini售价6999元起

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252107308269.jpg
就在刚刚，苹果正式更新了 Mac mini 产品线，售价 6999 元起，首发搭载全新一代 2nm 制程的 M6 芯片，同时提供 M5 Pro 版本可选，8 月 25 日开启订购，9 月 22 日正式发售。
·首次在主流级 M 系列配备 12 核 CPU（2 颗 Super Core + 4 颗性能核心 + 6 颗能效核心），相比 M4 增加 2 颗核心，多线程性能最高提升 40%；
·图形部分升至 12 核 GPU，并首次在 Mac mini 的 GPU 中加入神经网络加速器（Neural Accelerator），本地 LLM 等 AI 计算性能相比 M4 最高提升 4 倍，图形性能最高达到 M4 的 2 倍；
·GPU 升级动态缓存、光线追踪和增强型着色器核心，新增 FP8 支持；
·神经网络引擎升级为两组 16 核设计，峰值 AI 计算性能最高翻倍；
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252107399301.jpg
·统一内存带宽达到 170GB/s，最大支持 32GB 统一内存。
除了带来2nm芯片首秀的Mac mini外，Mac Studio的更新则是专业用户等待已久的实力兑现。
M5 Max：18核CPU，性能较前代提升30%；40核GPU，图形性能提升50%；每颗GPU核心集成神经加速器，AI任务处理速度提升4倍。CAD建模、游戏开发、长上下文AI推理，这些场景的体感提升是肉眼可见的。
M5 Ultra则采用新一代Ultra Fusion技术，这次进化到四芯片架构，最高支持512GB统一内存，内存带宽达1.2TB/s。互联带宽超4TB/s，连接密度较上代提升6倍以上。36核CPU（12超大核+24性能核），80核GPU，首次在Ultra芯片中引入神经加速器，AI算力提升4.3倍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252107476408.jpg
Mac Studio M5 Max 起售19999元，M5 Ultra 46999元。

items.title: 《影之刃零》Steam预估销量爆炸！达黑神话同期73%
items.summary: 近日，根据行业数据分析机构Alinea Analytics的最新预估数据显示，国产武侠动作游戏《影之刃零》（Phantom Blade Zero）有望实现爆…

others.title: 《影之刃零》Steam预售销量达《黑神话》同期73%，愿望单人数已突破200万

content.v: 近日，根据行业数据分析机构Alinea Analytics的最新预估数据显示，国产武侠动作游戏《影之刃零》（Phantom Blade Zero）有望实现爆款首发。
根据Alinea的估算，开启预购一周内，《影之刃零》在Steam平台的预购销量，已经带来约1450万美元营收，Alinea同时将本作和其他国产大作进行了对比，《影之刃零》的这份数据，已经达到《黑神话：悟空》同期惊人数据的73%，是《明末：渊虚之羽》同期预购数据的6.4倍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252043583777.jpeg
除此之外，机构数据表明，《影之刃零》愿望单人数已突破200万，在Steam愿望单排行榜大幅领先，是今年待发售游戏当中愿望单数量最高的作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252044244749.jpeg
VGI分析截图
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252044409483.png
Alinea特别强调，《影之刃零》和《黑神话：悟空》有着非常相似的气质：高预算制作、画面表现惊艳，根植本土文化的国产动作游戏，同时收获东西方玩家共鸣。然而这并不能代表《影之刃零》肯定会复刻《黑神话：悟空》那样的现象级热度，但不可否认，能够和《黑神话：悟空》处在同一量级区间，本作的起点已经格外强劲。
分析师 Daniel Camilo表示，《黑神话：悟空》是属于一代人一遇的文化现象，几乎所有中国国内的受众都能接触到相关话题，海外的玩家也都有所耳闻，而《影之刃零》的受众则更多集中在核心玩家群体，不过体量同样巨大。当然后续热度也存在持续发酵、雪球式增长的可能性。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252045188739.jpeg
《影之刃零》还获得了PlayStation的高度宣发支持：索尼为《影之刃零》专门举办了20分钟State of Play 专场发布会，以及PlayStation官方的多篇专题报道。在PS5平台上，游戏还将支持触觉反馈、自适应扳机、3D音频等功能。Alinea指出，这种宣发待遇对于第三方外部游戏来说是十分罕见的，换言之，《影之刃零》拿到了堪比索尼第一方游戏级别的宣传资源。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252045294644.png

与此同时，《影之刃零》现已经拿到国内版号，可以正式在中国大陆上线，充分挖掘本土市场潜力。加上功夫传奇巨星甄子丹以创意监制、核心动捕演员的身份全程深度参与，从功夫理念、动作体系、镜头叙事、临场武打编排等全方位共同创作，让游戏战斗体系取材于原汁原味的中国武术，为《影之刃零》搭建起一套独属于中式功夫内核的动作设计体系。游戏还融入大量精彩的中国文化遗产元素，包括舞狮、峨眉剑法、京剧、水墨美术等诸多特色内容。不难看出，本作同样能唤起和《黑神话：悟空》相似的民族自豪感。
《影之刃零》将于10月29日登陆PS5、PS5 Pro以及 PC（Steam、Epic、WeGame、TapTap PC）平台，有望成为2026年商业表现最亮眼的作品之一，值得玩家们期待。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608252045456944.png

content.v: 受经典《辐射》系列启发的后末日开放世界CRPG《Rad New World》Steam商店页公开，游戏登陆Steam抢先体验。玩家将作为一名孤独的流浪者生存下去。创建你的角色，升级特长，探索废土，使用近战与枪械战斗，开锁、交易，并在废墟中一路豪赌。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787660747_966384_jpg_r.jpg
《Rad New World》–后末日开放世界RPG
在这款受复古风格启发的后末日CRPG中，沉浸于一片残酷而美丽的废土，体验生存与风格的完美碰撞。
《Rad New World》将粗粝的垃圾摇滚/朋克美学与经典西部风情融为一体。你将扮演孤胆浪客，探索一个广阔而残酷的开放世界，这里充满了危险、机遇与极高的可重复游玩性。
通过深度角色创建和丰富的特长系统塑造你的游玩风格，铸就属于你的传奇。无论你是能言善道的商人、重型武器专家，还是隐秘的开锁高手，在这片放射性边境中，每一个选择都至关重要。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787660747_285065_jpg_r.jpg
核心特色：
广阔的开放世界–漫游充满隐藏遗迹、危险派系和奇特遭遇的废土。使用经典的大地图进行战略旅行和随机事件。
引人入胜的战斗–精通徒手、近战、投掷以及包含小型、中型和重型武器的完整军火库。战术定位、下蹲、爬行和动态移动让每场战斗都保持紧张刺激。
深度的RPG系统–升级角色，选择强大特长，管理增益与减益状态（辐射、成瘾、伤势等），并做出影响任务和派系的深远对话选择。
生存与探索–开锁闯入安全建筑，与可疑商人讨价还价，搜刮珍贵装备，并制作必需物品。驾驶载具穿越废土，并通过移动物品栏系统管理物资。
赌博与风险–通过扑克、骰子、老虎机、竞技场下注以及作弊机制测试你的运气，体验高回报的玩法。
流畅的移动与沉浸感–行走、奔跑、下蹲、攀爬、爬行和驾驶，穿梭于一个奖励探索和巧妙战术的活生生的世界中。

items.title: 植物大战僵尸，还能有恐怖版？
items.summary: 阴间纸人，血肉扭曲，恐怖版植物大战僵尸有多吓人

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
2024年，随着《植物大战僵尸》杂交版的爆火，国内有关植物大战僵尸各种改版的风潮来到了顶峰。
与此同时，许多节奏也在爆火之后找上了这个本来小众的圈子，“杂交版”陷入抄袭风波，“融合版”异军突起，各种改版疑似因版权问题同时宣布手机版停更，又在短时间内宣布无事发生......
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/14197.jpg
经过两年时间的沉淀，PVZ改版圈，似乎已经回到了之前稳定的样子，曾经一鸣惊人的作品如今稳步更新，一部分忠实玩家继续圈地自萌，好像平静的日子就会这样持续下去......
直到今年八月，杂交版热潮的两年后，PVZ改版圈再次迎来了点燃互联网的出圈宠儿——《植物大战僵尸》恐怖版。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/14622.jpg
具体有多“出圈”呢？
8月17日晚，著名明日方舟区主播Zc在直播游玩“恐怖版”的时候，直播间同时观看人数直接来到了3w人，不仅Zc上瘾玩到半夜，直播间的大部分观众，也跟着追到了很晚。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/16569.jpg
如此盛况虽然跟你周哥本人的影响力脱不了干系吧，但PVZ恐怖版本身过硬的质量也算就此打出了名堂，在此之后的一周《植物大战僵尸》恐怖版，简直成了公认的流量密码，只要随便哪个游戏区的主播直播游玩，不论出不出名，都一定会收获观众的欢迎和围观。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/18092.jpg
有关其的讨论，也在短短一周之内在B站大量增殖，试玩实况，剧情解析，各类二创层出不穷，现在只要你想，甚至能纯靠云就把恐怖版迄今为止的内容了解个大差不差。
这看上去猎奇慎人的奇葩二创改版游戏，到底哪里吸引人了？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/18104.jpg
恐怖版最明显的一处改动就是，大部分的植物和僵尸都像是被什么不干净的东西缠上了一样，从里到外透着一股子邪气。
淌着脓血怪笑的向日葵，腐烂生疮的坚果墙，腥臭下水组成的内脏团，被蛆虫占领的豌豆射手.....各种恶心又诡异的植物成为了这个版本的主角。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/32014.jpg
而他们的对手——僵尸，更是没一个是善茬。面色阴森惨白的纸人，吐着长舌的吊死鬼，血肉不规则凝聚在一起的畸变体，还有......区。
反正就各种阴间玩意往你草坪上招呼，而且个顶个的都是机制怪，原版大哥来都不一定干得过的那种。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/origin_202608252021096949.gif
所以，它的玩法相较于原版，也作出了较大的改动，突出一个机制怪成群，数值再高也不顶用。
就比如刚刚说过的那个“淌着脓血怪笑的向日葵”，这玩意叫诡笑葵，除了能产阳光，还会感染你前一格的植物，如果你用玩原版的习惯在它面前顺手摆个高坚果啥的抗压，就会体验到被这超级内鬼背刺的痛——原本还能撑一会的战线会在它把高坚果感染成同类的时候瞬间溃散。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/origin_202608252021216805.gif
而僵尸那边也都是高手，比如这个大前期就会出现的纸人，除了出场的时候伴随阴间音效吓你一跳之外还特别硬，也不逛街也不攻击植物，就纯碍事，往豌豆脸上一刷直接挡住一整排，最过分的是它还会复活和增值，如果不用特殊的植物针对，就会刷的到处都是。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/32197.jpg
敌我双方的猎奇玩意几百几千字是完全讲不完的，什么四人抬轿的鬼新娘，敌我不分的血佛，会过来毛走植物的乞讨者，要多变态有多变态，但是这不意味着整个恐怖版里就都全是这些一眼“反派”，机制数值两手抓的阴间玩意。
还有画风明显更加光明的“正方”，我方前期MVP道士玉米：眉清目秀的同时能够克制诡异僵尸。意外成为盟友的僵尸幸存者：会从后方出现帮忙迎击变异的僵尸......
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/33619.jpg
但......这些“恐怖版”里少见的“光”，大部分都在剧情里悲惨地“牺牲”，变成了“牢字辈”被作者送去坐了冷板凳。
是的，恐怖版与其他PVZ改版最大的不同，还不是植物和僵尸的创新，而是跟着关卡同步更新的剧情，而剧情，也正是“恐怖版”能够火遍全网的另一个绝招。
借助每一关开始时“主角”写下的日记，玩家们能够大致了解到，这个世界为什么会变成这样一个猎奇玩意到处逛的人间地狱。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260825_hzf_653_1/33826.jpg
我们从日记中看着各种诡异的僵尸纷至沓来，手中的植物纷纷变异，还看着主角一点点从正常人变成能够坦然摘下自己眼球，把帮助自己的植物通通背刺掉的超级狠人......这些日记的恐怖之处还要更胜阴间植物和僵尸几分。
剧情的作用确实不容忽视，关于剧情的讨论，和依据剧情内容的二创，正是恐怖版能够维持热度的关键。
玩家们自发地分析弥补了那些剧情中没有提到的细节，自发地解答抱有疑问的网友的问题，在各种“正常植物”在剧情中退场后为它们制作“遗照”，甚至还有人二创了娘化版的诡异植物......
于是，在玩家们的主动传播讨论下，PVZ恐怖版由外而内地在互联网上扎了根，也连带着让一般路过的路人，记住了作者“对不起贱笑了”的名字。
然后......大伙就发现了他是“猫猫向日葵”和“烧杯向日葵”的作者，没人知道从可爱的猫猫向日葵到阴间诡笑葵期间他都经历了什么，这下颤颤巍巍见自己了。
总而言之，PVZ的恐怖版无疑算得上PVZ社区的又一次爆火出圈。短短一周的时间就在普通玩家和各大主播的直播间疯狂增殖，让所有刷到的人都开始好奇起了这个画风粗糙，氛围阴间的改版，到底有什么魅力。
而上述内容，其实也不过只是“恐怖版”的序章罢了，如今作者正以视频的形式日更新的植物，僵尸乃至剧情，而有关它的讨论，或许在故事讲完之前都不会彻底消退吧。
可话虽如此，也难免会有人觉得“恐怖版”还不够精致。美术画面脏兮兮的，玩法充斥着各式各样的BUG和问题，就连好评如潮的剧情也多少沾点故弄玄虚......
但恰恰是这种“非工业化，非体系化”的诡异猎奇Cult味，构成了PVZ恐怖版最核心的气质，让它不再仅仅只是“《植物大战僵尸》的民间改版”，而是成为了“恐怖化二创”这一庞大亚文化分类中的一份子。
其实，这种玩家自发创造的，对童年作品的“恐怖解构”一直是同人创作中非常常见的表现形式，不如说美术不够精致，体系不够完善，故事不算完整，才是他们该有的形态。
当那些在我们童年记忆中轻松愉快的形象，只是换了一个风格出现在我们面前时，我们的注意力也总会自然而然地被吸引。
鬼畜天线宝宝，比奇堡的恐怖传说，被诅咒的游戏卡带，谋害玩家的经典童年游戏IP形象......我相信你一定见过类似的东西。
它们有的是采用童年作品中的角色，用恐怖主题去重新诠释，成为了一代人记忆中的经典，比如大名鼎鼎的同人游戏《野比大雄的生化危机》。
它们有的是诞生于互联网恐怖创作网站creepypasta的劣质二创，在意外爆火后被制作成了同人游戏系列一直传播，比如索尼克.EXE。
有的，则是创作者故意摆弄都市传说，供网友们解谜游玩的现实解密游戏ARG，像是之前我们也讨论过的塞尔达“溺死的Ben事件”。
只是，不论是游戏，还是动画，这些“恐怖化解构”的精髓所在，就是他们根深蒂固的成人二创属性。
所有对童年经典作品的“恐怖化二创”一定要是成人的，小众的，免费不盈利且有着浓重创作者个人性才能够成立，就像我们如今提到的PVZ恐怖版一样。
否则，就容易向着某些不太好的领域坍塌......比如，被定性为“鞋垫”遭到彻底封杀。
那么问题来了，为什么这种看上去颇具“鞋垫”味的恐怖，会顶着风险坚持不懈地以我们熟知的童年作品为载体传播呢？
答案其实很简单，“熟悉的东西变得陌生”是一种纯度很高的恐惧载体。
正是因为我们在儿童时期被这些作品的原版打动过，再看到恐怖化改造时，才会同样被猎奇心里牵动着去了解被改版后的它们，并再次爱上已经面目全非的“童年”。
毕竟只有对它们本来的样子有概念，才会对恐怖化改造后的形状生出别样的情绪，不论那是恐惧，欣赏，还是怀念。
于是，作者们以及那些逐渐长大成人的受众们，才能够在这片曾经熟悉的土壤中去种植那些恐怖诡异的二次创作。这些对童年ip的恐怖化改造，或许正是一代人，回望自己童年的一种方式。
这是一种反差也是一种默契，更是独属于一代人的亚文化形式。
我的童年并没有小霸王之外的，能被称作“游戏主机”的东西，所以，提到索尼克和塞尔达IP的恐怖二创时，我还得去互联网上寻找资料。
而《植物大战僵尸》，只需去我的记忆中探寻即可。

items.title: 《GTA6》泄露视频13 海滩NPC细节令人惊叹

content.v: 随着每天两分钟的泄露继续进行，我们最新看到的《GTA6》场景是在傍晚的海滩上，杰森骑着自行车在沙滩上穿梭，周围是成群结队的晒太阳者，其中一些NPC的变化之大，我认为是游戏史上前所未见的。
很难理解《GTA6》爆料者Cyberleek为何如此频繁地发布光线极其昏暗的非官方视频。就像之前的视频一样，这段视频同样昏暗，如果换个时间拍摄，本可以更好地展现这款画面惊艳的游戏。
不过，抛开这点不谈，这次的非官方“宣传活动”再次揭示了一些其他游戏从未展现过的细节。这次的亮点是人群NPC。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787659727_519201.webp
对于那些拥有大量人群的游戏来说，NPC的设计上出现一些重复是很常见的事情。有时这种重复显得滑稽可笑，有时则伪装得很好，但《GTA6》绝不是这种情况。
在这段视频中，你都很难找到两次相同颜色的泳裤或泳衣，更别说两次是同一个人了。就像昨天发布的果体营地视频一样，这段海滩场景展现了各种各样的体型、肤色，或许最令人难以置信的是，他们各自独特的动作和动作。不仅如此，这群人并非在你靠近时才突然出现，而是即使远距离也能清晰地看到他们，即使在这段画质不佳的视频中，他们的独特特征也清晰可见。
游戏里的语音也很棒。《GTA6》延续了以往的传统，玩家角色一出现，人们就会反应过度，比如“别盯着我的胸看了，好吗?我知道它们很棒，但是……”其他一些我很喜欢的台词还有：“我是这里最火辣的妞儿之一”和“今天就用“美人鱼婊子”这个标签，对吧?！”
当然，《GTA6》的海滩NPC并不完美。偶尔会有些怪异的瞬间，比如几个男人走过时，他们的背包会凭空出现;还有个男人瘫坐在躺椅上，骑车经过时身体微微摇晃，但这些瑕疵都被这里整体的魅力所掩盖。人们用手机屏幕拍摄集体照或自拍时闪烁的光芒，退潮时海水轻柔地拍打着人们的双腿，低垂的阳光在人们的皮肤上投下长长的影子：这一切都令人叹为观止。

items.title: The upcoming Resident Evil movie will have first-person POVs as it demonstrates how authenticity is a moving target for a series that spans 30 years
items.summary: Up close and personal.

others.title: These 10+ Commodore 64 Games Are Coming to PS5 Soon
Witcher 4 Release Window Narrowed Down, As Dev Teases “A Surprise Or Two” At Gamescom About Other Things

content.v: If there's one thing I know about the upcoming Resident Evil film it's that the director Zach Cregger is doing the utmost to stay true to the series' roots. "I happen to worship these Resident Evil games and pull a lot of inspiration from the experience of playing them," Cregger reminds fans in a recent interview with DiscussingFilm .

I've already explained why this means he knows ball . But authenticity is a moving target for a series which just turned 30 years old, and has made some pretty monumental changes over the last three decades. Exactly what Cregger chooses to remain true to isn't as clear cut as some may think.

Zach Cregger reveals what gameplay elements are included in his ‘RESIDENT EVIL’ movie.“He’s constantly coming up against these padlocks that stop him from progressing. [There's also] healing spray cans, the green herbs.” pic.twitter.com/H2mICigeBH August 24, 2026

One example of this can be found in the latest teaser for the film, which shows a first-person camera angle of Bryan creeping through corridors and shooting down some speedy infected. An OG Resident Evil fan could faint at the sight of this, as traditionally, a third-person or fixed perspective were what you would see in a Resident Evil game. But this isn't the late 90s anymore, in fact, Resident Evil hasn't had an new exclusively third person perspective for almost a decade now.

Apart from that little hiccup at the start of 2000, 2017 was the first time Resident Evil scrapped the third person perspective with Resident Evil 7: Biohazard , with Capcom opting for a first-person perspective instead.

It was initially met with a negative knee-jerk reaction as players (myself included) feared that Resident Evil was about to be taken down a gimmicky FPS road, but we were wrong, and Biohazard managed to pull it off so well that first-person has now become a staple for the series with Resident Evil 8: Village and Requiem having both first and third person options. And dare I say, first-person suits Village better.
New look at first-person POV in Zach Cregger's ‘RESIDENT EVIL’.Multiple shooting action sequences in the film have first-person POV inspired by the games. pic.twitter.com/MuZkReoiJT August 24, 2026

"This is an opportunity for me to be loyal to the games in spirit and in tone, and build a story that just puts you in that scenario again, and again, and again, with increasing stakes," Cregger adds, again reminding players that this adaptation isn't meant to be a 1:1 shot recreation of any of the games, but instead an amalgamation of ideas, traits, and vibes that the games employ.

In the same way, Cregger has explained that he's tried to recreate the game's progression by keeping "the environment changing every seven or eight minutes" always pushing the protagonist forward as if he's "moving onto another level." This is also helped by the fact that Bryan will move through weapons much like a protagonist in one of the games would: "You start with a pistol, and then you graduate to a shotgun, and then you graduate to a machine gun."

In the grand scheme of things, camera perspectives will play a small part in how successful the film is. But all these little nods to the games combined will serve as a solid foundation if Cregger manages to pull it all off, which I really hope he does.

content.v: 苹果在2024年末再度升级桌面一体机，推出了新款iMac，采用了惊艳的纤薄设计，提供了纳米纹理显示屏选项以及多种全新色彩，搭载了M4芯片，带有12MP Center Stage摄像头，并支持雷雳4连接功能。时间已经过去快两年了，也差不多轮到iMac产品线更新。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260825/1787658669_347669_jpg_r.jpg
据VideoCardz报道，苹果准备在今年末发布新的iMac，将搭载M6芯片，预计还会有新配色。自从转向自研芯片以来，iMac的更新相比于MacBook系列更为规律，从2021年推出重新设计的24英寸型号，搭载M1芯片，再到跳过M2转向M3芯片，接着改变内部设计，搭载M4芯片，接下来跳过M5改用M6芯片，新款将保留现有整体设计，也将是一次小幅度更新。
传闻M6系列是苹果首批采用台积电（TSMC）2nm工艺的芯片之一，与今年iPhone所使用的A20系列芯片采用相同的工艺，有望在性能和能效方面带来明显改善。与过去有些不同的是，传闻这次M6系列仅提供基础版，M6 Pro和M6 Max已经取消，高端芯片直接跳到M7系列。
此前苹果已经在基础款MacBook Pro机型中测试M6芯片，在CPU微架构和NPU设计上加入了多项改进，以支持本地AI处理。统一内存带宽相比M5芯片的153GB/s会进一步提高，预计达到200GB/s，另外GPU核心数量也将从10个升至12个。

content.v: 作者：白广大
2026年7月4日，上海，中国音数协游戏博物馆。
一群平均年龄超过四十五岁的游戏媒体人围坐一堂，用一个下午回溯中国游戏产业三十年的来时路。
https://image.gcores.com/076379f6a59a8d7b3bba6049bb4b716b-3375-2250.png
三十年前，他们中有人在没有暖气的四合院里，用胶卷相机拍摄电视屏幕上的升龙拳；三十年后，中国游戏市场年销售收入3507.89亿元，玩家6.83亿。
从筚路蓝缕到烈火烹油，中间隔着一整代人的生活。每年夏天，都是游戏产业最火热的时段。知乎上的游戏讨论也会迎来新的峰值。今年夏天，知乎推出了"游戏浪一夏"活动。有厂商联动、有主题周、有福利，也有大量玩家围绕游戏留下的具体讨论。
当2026年的夏天里，国产游戏密集亮相，二游、竞技与作品型游戏各自进入新阶段，玩家需要什么样的地方讨论它们？一款预告片又怎样从一条视频，变成一群人可以共同检验、争论、补充的文化事件？
7月4日的那场沙龙，给出过第一个答案。
到了8月，ChinaJoy上的《抵抗者》、8月20日公开的《黑神话：钟馗》实机演示、定档10月29日的《影之刃零》，以及在知乎上热烈深入的讨论，又给我们带来另一种发展中的，未定型的可能。
一、一梦三十年：一群老登玩家在新时代的对话
看材质猜《死亡搁浅》，看卡普空红黄相间的血条猜《快打旋风》，看固定战斗背景猜《传说之下》……
7月4日下午，知乎主办的“游戏回忆故事会”沙龙由资深游戏媒体人火狼开场，他拿来暖场的这套“看像素块猜游戏”，就像一次快速的游戏史点名：开放世界、街机、独立游戏、格斗游戏在十几分钟内排成一列，压轴的一张图来自1994年，金盘电子杨南征老师推出的《神鹰突击队》，被普遍看作中国大陆第一款商业化电子游戏，游研社还存着杨南征的亲笔签名版。
现场有人认出了它，也有人只知道"这是一款国产游戏"。两个答案都很诚实：对于老玩家，国产游戏的来处是一串具体的公司、杂志、游戏卡和软件店；对于后来者，它首先是一段需要重新讲述的历史。
作为与会嘉宾里最年轻的人，我在自我介绍时说：在座各位都是我看着文章长大的前辈，只有我的头发还没白。
很远的回忆：9600波特率的时代，玩家选择相信，编辑选择认真
软体动物1994年入职《电软》时，编辑部在北京鼓楼附近一个四合院厢房里，平房，冬天没暖气，几个人晚上玩游戏到深夜不回家，把凳子和单人床拼成大通铺。当时他已经开始上网，速率9600波特——大约只有拨号时代末期56K猫的六分之一。
"那个时候没有采集卡，我们拿相机拍。"格斗游戏的配图是这么来的：两个人对打，旁边请一位摄影师，用胶片相机对着电视按快门，一晚上拍完好几卷，能挑出几张可用的就算丰收。排版用照排机出胶片，再把照片底片嵌进去——那个年代《电子游戏软件》游戏图旁歪歪斜斜的黑边，就是这么来的。

Gouki入行晚了六年，才知道世界上有一种电脑不叫Windows、叫MAC，排版用PageMaker，图片存在比3.5英寸软盘厚的zip磁盘里传递。他负责的第一款游戏是《超时空之轮》，截图卡只能插视频线，他把整个游戏无声通关，别人问他觉不觉得音乐好，他完全不知道对方在说什么。为给杂志做图，他下载Namco《铁拳TT》一个5M的预告片，挂了整整一晚上；为拿一张能做封面的图，编辑部会花几百元请人去香港买杂志。
这些故事说明，早期游戏媒体的"艰苦"不是一句情怀。
一本杂志要经历选题、试玩、写稿、截图、翻译、排版、校对、印刷，再运往全国。那时候的信息是物理的沉重：资讯从海外传到国内，要经杂志快递、磁盘、BBS、拨号网络一层层搬回来——五寸盘、三寸盘、长途电话、传真清单、邮寄复印件。
同样的信息密度，我们今天叫做“长文”，它与知乎很相似，也完全不同。
相似在于玩家仍需要一个中间环节，帮自己从海量信息里挑出值得看的；不同在于，如今稀缺的不再是资讯本身，而是注意力、判断力和可信的表达——一条预告片的传播速度快了几十万倍，真正完整看完、玩过并认真回答的人反而更难找。
当年编辑搬运信息，是在补信息空白；今天的内容创作者要做的，更多是把一款作品放进语境里：它为什么这样设计？历史背景是什么？系统是否支撑表达？争论究竟是在谈游戏，还是在谈服务、价格和运营？问题从"我能不能知道"，变成了"我应该相信什么"。
不太远的回忆：网速快了，玩家更快了
从纸媒时代过度到互联网时代，知乎、触乐、游研社与机核出现在同一个画面里。cOMMANDO说成败"60%到70%看当时的时间"——触乐网2013年成立时资本活跃，做媒体拿得到投资，经过多年，他悟出创作者有保质期，"悠着点，不要特别燃烧，留一点给自己缓回来的时间"。

从游研社一端，Oracle经历过版号停发和玩家从手游转向Steam、主机的阶段，他印象最深的是《足球经理2016》无中文的差评分析——那是中国玩家第一次大规模用差评向厂商表达语言诉求，也是"游戏变成服务型产品"的标志。聊到玩家群体的变化，Oracle的观察很准：十年前，大多数人把游戏当成一部作品去体验；现在，越来越多的玩家把游戏当成一种服务，把自己当成被服务的对象，很多行业争议都源于这两种心态的割裂。
于是，作为机核的代表，我在台上被问到了"奇迹"：那期节目直到今天还挂在机核主站和B站上没有下架。我说，这件事给机核留下两条遗产：一是我会对每一个新来的编辑说，每个人都会有自己的"奇迹时刻"，这是表达者必经的部分，靠聪明回避不掉；二是作为表达者，"有一半工资来自于受伤害"——观点不同的人把分歧变成攻击抛过来，那就是另一半工资的来源。
https://image.gcores.com/db2d72c52f8b74defad9cffc0cef1925-3504-2336.png
但我真正想说的是：现在的玩家最渴求真实的接触——屏幕上的文字、图片、声音、视频都证明不了对面有个完整的人，线下才能。
真实的游戏和人，才能够给玩家带来足够的乐趣与希望。
二、攻城略地在此时：信息传递的快、深、准
故事会上有观众问：从纸媒到互联网时代，什么是不变的。Gouki只答一句："一颗分享的心，没有这颗心，你根本干不了这一行。"
这句话1996年成立，2026年同样成立，区别在于体量。

1996年，杂志读者在玩《金庸群侠传》《暗黑破坏神》《红色警戒》，本土有《中关村启示录》；2000年游戏机禁令出台，单机市场一路收缩——2004年网游产值24.7亿元时单机只剩1亿元，2008年网游183.6亿元，单机3060万元。再看2026年：2025年国内游戏市场实际销售收入3507.89亿元，用户6.83亿，自研游戏海外收入204.55亿美元，全部创历史新高；游戏出海写入国家"十五五"规划相关表述，版号发放常态化。
人群结构同样在变：女性玩家、银发玩家各自撑起稳定赛道，电竞观众、单机玩家、二游玩家各自拥有高度垂直的舆论阵地。
圈层越细，对讨论质量的要求越高，泛泛的资讯搬运在这种结构里活不下去。
产业数字说明盘子大了，玩家有感的是氛围——有没有地方聊，有没有人聊，聊的东西能不能看。
这恰好是知乎今年夏天在做的事。
夏天里的六大游戏主题周
除开展对游戏产业的宏观讨论之外，以微观视角观察单个游戏样本同样重要。"游戏浪一夏"活动以六大主题周推进，联合绝区零、鸣潮、崩坏：星穹铁道、明日方舟：终末地、英雄联盟、无畏契约等厂牌，把赛事、新作、版本内容拆成讨论单元。传播清单里能看到赛事杂谈、深度测评、游戏漫谈等等热议内容，参与玩家可以获取丰富的游戏道具和知乎盐粒奖励，他们也将讨论推向了不同维度：不在同一条赛道上，也不该用同一把尺子评判。
知乎的作用不在于替玩家宣布统一答案，它的问答结构更适合把一句"好不好玩"，拆成"为什么这样设计""这个题材的难点在哪里""这次改动对玩家意味着什么"。话题来源五花八门，承接方式却高度一致——先问是不是，再问为什么，然后摆证据。知乎游戏区最值钱的就是这种讨论习惯，一项活动把它集中调度起来，形成有密度的讨论场。

更重要的是，知乎上有大量的游戏产业从业者，能够从工作本身出发，为提出问题的人们带来精准的答案。比如《英雄联盟》"经典模式"好不好玩、提莫技能组从未变化是不是因为太优秀——一个玩梗的问题，底下认真讨论起英雄设计的冗余度和学习成本；索尼宣布2028年1月起不再生产实体盘，知乎上的讨论从所有权聊到数字存档，一条行业新闻引出定价、所有权、垄断、文明传承四层话题；角色建模为什么做不出长裙的飘逸和"门不能从另一侧打开"是否泛滥这类问题下，答主里有真正做过布料模拟和关卡设计的从业者，答案带着工程现场的颗粒感。
https://image.gcores.com/6be9fb51b6f73b3a43946f5bd01046b5-1512-1318.png
文化线上还有"东方侠影"第二季圆桌，主题"何为东方何为侠"。讨论从"武侠最重要的是'武'还是'侠'"展开：为什么越来越多的游戏做出了武，却越来越少人谈侠？嘉宾名单里有《隐形守护者》《名利游戏》《江山北望》的制作人帝皇今、《无相刀》制作人洪子，都是正在做"东方表达"的人。
https://image.gcores.com/ba84cfa42000a5115eba130a064531ab-1200-500.png
我以为，这些讨论并没有标准答案，但需要更多答案。答案之间的分歧恰好是国产游戏在文化表达上真实的分歧：有人信技术先行，有人信叙事为本，有人信把"武"做扎实了，"侠"自然浮现。两种尺度能同时存在，正是讨论氛围成熟的表现——国产游戏已经不再只是"有没有"的问题，玩家开始认真追问"怎么做得更好"。
三、国产游戏之夏：厚积薄发的8月
作品型赛道：八月密集亮剑
2026年下半年的国产作品型游戏，供给密度到了前所未有的水平。这个夏天的节奏可以串成三个节点：7月30日、8月12日、8月20日。

7月30日，浩汤科技开发的抗日题材FPS《抵抗者》发布全新实机演示，IGN的评价是"不禁让人回想起EA《荣誉勋章》最鼎盛的那个年代"。四大章节覆盖抗战重要时期，谍战解谜与高强度射击结合，战役约15小时，虚幻5引擎，战场横跨林海雪原、江南水乡、上海石库门。演示发布一天内，主流视频平台累计播放量超过760万；次日ChinaJoy开幕，游戏在N1馆G201展位首次开放线下试玩，Steam愿望单同步开放（目前标注"即将推出"），支持14国语言。现场水泄不通，试玩席位座无虚席，很多人直呼：没有想过会这么快就体验到国产抗日FPS的实机。
8月12日上午10点，《影之刃零》开启全平台预售，国区标准版268元、豪华版328元，定档10月29日全球同步，甄子丹担任监制的消息随预售公开。从社区反应看，玩家对"延期50天换品质"的接受度相当高——国产买断制玩家已经开始用成熟市场的方式理解档期逻辑。玩家可以支持延期换品质，也可以等真正玩到之后再评价：预告片负责展示方向，完整体验才负责检验结果。
8月20日上午10点，游戏科学发布《黑神话：钟馗》第一支实机视频，时长超15分钟，展示战斗系统与部分剧情片段。820对游科有特殊的仪式感：《黑神话：悟空》2020年8月20日首支预告，2024年同天发售，销量超三千万；《钟馗》2025年同天在科隆公布先导预告，一年后实机落地，节奏严丝合缝。杨奇当天的表态值得记下：直面被骂，不做单纯讨好的创意。
https://image.gcores.com/ccb63650d10e50d0312fb14c90933848-1590-1206.png
三个节点之外，队伍还很长：ChinaJoy现场国产作品的占比和排队长度远超往年；8月26日科隆展开幕夜紧跟其后；12月TGA同样是国产游戏的固定档期，《影之刃零》的发售日就公布于去年TGA。
从8月到年底，作品会继续处在"持续见面"的状态：有的进入发售，有的继续公开实机，有的可能延期，也有的在讨论里安静下来。作品型游戏从"一年盼一部"变成"一个季度数不过来"，不代表每一款都会成功，却意味着行业拥有更多可以被检验的样本。
二游赛道：内容工业的日常运转
二游的热度形态完全不同：作品型靠节点爆发，二游靠日常版本运转维持讨论水位，考验内容工业的持续供给。绝区零、鸣潮、崩坏：星穹铁道、明日方舟：终末地，作品不会在通关后结束，角色、地图、音乐、活动剧情、版本机制持续更新，玩家在里面生活的时间比买断制长得多。
而这类产品，在知乎上讨论的空间和持久热度也值得关注：

以《绝区零》为例，7月底Fami通发布部分角色设计稿，知乎上的讨论围绕角色视觉语言展开，精度接近专业的设定评论；角色蕾米埃尔的EP《Two to Tango》发布后，从作曲到PV分镜的拆解出现在回答区。一个角色的音乐EP能撑起上千字的认真分析，说明围绕这类内容已有稳定的专业解读群体。《鸣潮》《崩坏：星穹铁道》《明日方舟：终末地》的讨论也各有侧重：有人关注版本节奏，有人把角色与世界观并置，有人从工业化生产和长期运营的角度提问。
https://image.gcores.com/475f4745525d684a3e384d3e96801e7d-1475-1280.jpg

items.title: 人类消失后的世界：在桌面上 养一个微型社会！
items.summary: 一棵树上养出整个小社会！增量放置游戏《米粒新世界》Demo现已开放

content.v: 人类已经消失，世界却没有因此安静太久。
一群个头小小、每天忙得团团转的小家伙爬上了巨树。它们采集树液、搬运废料、织出丝线，在枝杈间修建工坊和仓库，还会随着族群壮大不断发展出新的工作与分工。最开始只是树枝上零零散散的几个身影，慢慢地，却能在你的桌面上发展成一个热热闹闹的小社会。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251920067008.jpg
画风治愈的像素风增量放置游戏《米粒新世界》目前已在Steam开放Demo试玩。游戏将会支持简体中文，正式版也已开放愿望单，喜欢放置养成、资源经营，或者单纯喜欢观察一群小家伙忙忙碌碌的玩家，现在就可以提前体验。
APP用户【一键加入愿望单】
《米粒新世界》的故事发生在人类消失后的世界。
巨树成为了小家伙们生活和发展的家园，而属于这个新社会的第一步，可能只是玩家轻轻点下的一次操作。
将成员安排到不同设施后，它们便会自行投入工作，采集树液、废料、丝线等资源。积累下来的材料又可以继续投入生产、设施升级和新的建设，让整个循环不断向前推进。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/origin_202608251918055360.gif
最开始，很多事情还需要玩家亲自安排。随着设施逐渐完善，原本依赖手动操作的生产会慢慢自动运转。即使暂时去忙别的事情，树上的小家伙依旧会继续工作，资源数字也会一点点往上涨。
新的建筑、新的资源、新的职业随之出现，原本挤在一起干活的小群体，也逐渐有了更加明确的分工。
从“点一下试试看”，到回过神时发现整棵树都已经忙起来，这种不断扩张、不断自动化的过程，构成了《米粒新世界》最核心的增量放置体验。
当然，如果《米粒新世界》只有不断上涨的数字，树上的生活未免也太安静了一点。
拉近视角，就能看到小家伙们沿着树枝来回穿梭。
有的抱着刚刚收集好的材料一路小跑，有的钻进工坊开始生产，又从另一头抱着新的东西跑出来。建筑彼此连接，资源不断流转，每一个小小的身影似乎都有自己的事情要做。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/origin_202608251918142306.gif
玩家既可以把注意力放在资源效率、设施升级与发展路线之上，也可以偶尔停下来，看着这个迷你社会按照自己的节奏运转。
对于喜欢“赛博养蚂蚁”式观察体验的玩家来说，可能最大的乐趣之一，就是看着最初只有寥寥几个成员的树枝，一点一点被跑动的小身影填满。
《米粒新世界》的发展空间并不是一张固定的地图。
这个社会本身，就生长在巨树之上。
玩家可以消耗积累下来的资源培育新的树干和枝丫，让原本有限的生存空间继续向外延伸。新的区域出现之后，又能继续修建工坊、仓库以及更多奇妙设施，并逐渐解锁新的材料、功能与发展方向。
于是，游戏里的成长不仅表现为资源数字越来越大，也会直接反映在眼前这棵树的变化上。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/origin_202608251918221173.gif
曾经空荡荡的枝头开始出现新的建筑；零散的设施慢慢彼此连接；管道、屋舍与忙碌的小家伙铺满树冠。随着发展不断向上延伸，原本的一小块栖息地，也会逐渐变成一座生长在巨树上的迷你世界。
灯光一盏盏亮起来，小小的社会也就在这个过程中逐渐有了自己的模样。
当然，再稳定的放置生产，也偶尔需要一点意外。
《米粒新世界》中会不时出现各种随机事件，为日常发展带来额外变化。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/origin_202608251918301498.gif
有时会获得珍贵资源，有时则会出现临时增益，还有一些事情甚至连这些小家伙自己都不一定弄得明白。
但它们似乎也没有那么在意。
围过去热闹一阵，看看发生了什么，抱走能拿到的奖励，然后转身继续工作——对这些忙忙碌碌的小家伙来说，大概没有什么事情比手头的活更重要。
随机事件让原本稳定运转的增量循环里多了一些不可预测的小插曲，也让玩家每次回来看一眼自己的巨树时，都可能遇见新的东西。
采集、生产、升级、自动化，再从一根小小的枝条不断向更高处生长。
《米粒新世界》并不要求玩家始终紧盯屏幕。你可以认真研究资源配置与发展效率，也可以把它放在一边，偶尔回来看看今天又多了哪些建筑，又有哪些小家伙开始了新的工作。
从最初的几个小生命，到枝繁叶茂的巨树社会，整个世界会随着一次次点击和等待慢慢热闹起来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/25/small_202608251926367932.png
《米粒新世界》目前已在Steam开放Demo试玩，并支持简体中文。
如果你喜欢增量放置、资源经营，或者单纯想在桌面上养一群永远闲不下来的小家伙，现在即可前往Steam体验Demo，并将《米粒新世界》加入愿望单，等待这个小小世界正式开始生长。

items.title: The Golden Idol Saga Is Getting An Awesome New Physical Edition
items.summary: Two games, one cartridge. The Case of the Golden Idol and Rise of the Golden Idol , widely regarded as two of

content.v: Two games, one cartridge.

The Case of the Golden Idol and Rise of the Golden Idol , widely regarded as two of the finest detective games in recent memory, are being bundled together in one swanky physical package from Super Rare Games.

Both titles will be included in one cartridge for Switch, and buyers have the choice between a standard version (3,500 copies available) and a deluxe edition (1,500 copies available). Netflix will exclusively debut GTA 6 gameplay footage this Thursday, August 27 via its Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look , which will remain exclusive to the streaming platform for six hours. Here's when you can watch the show as soon as it debuts, and when it will arrive on other platforms such as YouTube.

While the past week has seen persistent GTA 6 leaks hit the headlines , these short snippets of open-world footage feel like they have only scratched the surface of what Rockstar has been building. Here's hoping this week reveals a good sense of both protagonists, Jason and Lucia, and our best look yet at the game's world in high-definition.

The past few months have seen a steady uptick in activity promoting GTA 6 after Rockstar revealed the cover art for GTA 6 back in June. Some fans had expected the game's third trailer to debut shortly after, but Rockstar instead released a big batch of new GTA 6 screenshots , which tease all kinds of new details about the game .

It's now been more than 500 days since the arrival of Trailer 2 back in May 2025 — so long ago that when you go back and watch it, the trailer still has GTA 6's previous release date attached to it. But rather than debut its long-awaited Trailer 3 alongside preorders , Rockstar has now confirmed this meatier look at the game, which is now just days away.

Check below to see when you'll be able to watch Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look in your region, initially via Netflix, then later on YouTube and elsewhere. And finally, a reminder that GTA 6 itself is due out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, 2026.

items.title: Be Quiet! Light Mount TKL review
items.summary: A very welcome TKL update that didn't quite leave me speechless.

content.v: My prime PC gaming hours tend to be when the rest of my household is already in bed. As such, the fantastically clicky-clacky key presses of a mechanical gaming keyboard echoing through our halls isn't really ideal. It's just as well then that Be Quiet! is back with a welcome update to the very nearly silent keyboard I loved last year, the Light Mount .

As someone with a perennially messy desk, the Light Mount TKL's 80% size is just right; I have room to swish my mouse, and I find I'm not forever accidentally hitting the capslock key as with other cut-down keebs. This TKL update offers more than just a smaller form factor, though, introducing the next generation of Be Quiet!'s Silent switches in Linear and Tactile flavours.

This TKL update also addresses one of the key problems I had with the original Light Mount by introducing new gaming features. This includes Quick Tap (SOCD), which will be sweet percussion to the ears of shooter fans—and at best eyebrow raising for the esports sickos. For those unfamiliar, SOCD stands for 'Simultaneous Opposing Cardinal Directions'. Features falling under this umbrella, like Razer's Snap Tap and now Be Quiet!'s Quick Tap, prioritises your most recent directional input, making for strafing so efficient that Valve banned it from Counter-Strike 2 .

Alongside Quick Tap, there's also more options for macros, and a few fresh customisation options within the IO center software. While I appreciate these additions and expansions, the TKL still isn't the most feature-packed gaming keyboard you'll find.

I still love the even-quieter switches, though. Coupled with the TKL's sturdy construction, this makes for another smart-looking package. However, it's rocking up to the rowdy PC gaming party as the quiet kid in the corner—that is to say, while some will definitely appreciate its charms, it can't compete with the louder, more popular keeb crowd.
Buy if...

✅ You want something that's actually quiet: If clackier keyboards are just too loud, this is the one for you. Better yet, the new V2 Silent switches are even quieter than their predecessors. ✅ You want a keyboard for both work and play: This board's smart looks mean it will be just as at home in the office as it is next to your RGB-illuminated rig.
Don't buy if...

❌ You're looking for a gaming keyboard that's the complete package: Though this does bring a few new things to Be Quiet's table, it's less fully-featured than other TKL options. ❌ You're working with an extremely limited amount of desk space: As an 80% keyboard, you can definitely go smaller.
Features
Be Quiet! Light Mount TKL
Switch
Be quiet! Silent V2 Linear Mechanical Switches (Tactile also available)
Size
Connection type
Wired
Cable
Braided USB Type-C/USB Type-A
Onboard storage
Yes
Backlight
RGB LED
Media controls
Tactile knob, twist for volume control, tap top to mute
Wristrest
Yes, magnetic attachment
Keycaps
PBT, double-shot
Weight
Price

The Light Mount TKL is an 80% keyboard that enjoys the latest generation of Be Quiet!'s Silent switches. Tactile switches are available, but my review unit came with the Silent Linear V2s (though if you're craving clicky-ness, the media knob in the keyboard's top left corner has got you covered). According to Be Quiet!, the new V2s feature thicker gold contact points for the copper lever inside, as well as 'optimised lubrication for quieter operation and improved responsiveness'—well, I'll be the judge of that.

The V1 switches were already astonishingly understated on the full-sized board, making the most of the original Light Mount's internal layers of sound dampening. The V2 switches on the TKL are somehow even quieter .

Though the new switches feel a bit on the firm side right out of the box, they soon actuate just as cleanly as the V1s. Before, I described typing on the Tactile V1s as a controlled descent onto solid ground, but the Linear V2s have a little more pleasing texture underhand. It's not like stepping on a discordantly crunchy leaf, it's more like tiptoeing over a thin layer of soft sand—I like it!

The combination of the V2s and the TKL's construction also means the space bar is now much quieter than what I found on this board's big brother. Although, it's worth noting that future productions of both the full size Light Mount and the Dark Mount will come with the new V2 switches.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7CWUJk5dQ8nYNuJr6qbtwn.jpg

So far, so excellent: the Light Mount TKL is an actually quiet mechanical keyboard that won't tattle on you during late night gaming sessions. So, what about those fresh gaming features? Well, let's get the least exciting addition out of the way first: You can now disable the Capslock key in Game Mode.

Cool. Moving swiftly on, the Light Mount TKL also enjoys Be Quiet's version of SOCD, Quick Tap, for the first time. Whereas the original Light Mount felt more like a fairly quiet mechanical keyboard you could also use for gaming, the TKL feels a smidge more like a gaming keyboard in its own right.

And you know what gamers love above all else? Bathing themselves in the glow of RGB lighting. Like its predecessors, the TKL implementation of RGB is similarly classy; a dedicated light strip lines the very top of the keyboard, and every switch below enjoys an 'ARGB diffuser' for tasteful per-key illumination. On top of plenty of customisation options in the IO Center software, the Light Mount TKL also features support for Microsoft Dynamic Lighting.
Performance
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/peaahbSdJbUAu9C75EtLgn.jpg

The Be Quiet! Light Mount TKL is a joy to type on. Switch-feel is really second to none in my mind. But what about gaming? Well, as I've said before, my most intense encounter in an online game recently was getting lost in Big Walk (not to mention how I tend to spend more time hiding in bushes in Arc Raiders than running and gunning). Similarly, this isn't a gaming keyboard with the competitive scene in mind. With those expectations set, let's get into it.

I tend to accidentally hit the Capslock key on smaller form factor keyboards, such as the Cherry XTRFY K5 Pro TMR Compact . The option to disable this key in Game Mode is definitely welcome, though I do find myself stumbling on to Capslock a lot less with this TKL. I also found this keyboard's layout and 1,000 Hz maximum polling rate does little to impede my running around the feline-themed post office of Cat Mail Co. The Shift key for sprinting between barely organised shelves is comfortably within reach—so long as you don't subconsciously curl your hand into a weird cat paw-esque grip like I do.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/eYqjzGmESNs74cxhQagqYn.jpg

The TKL's precision is definitely welcome as I roll up everything in sight in Once Upon a Katamari . The TKL's responsiveness already makes it easy to both slow my roll and steer clear of disaster. Quick Tap comes especially in handy here, making changing the direction of my Katamari all the snappier. Does that mean I start immediately smashing through all of my previous records? Eh, no, not exactly. A swish gaming keyboard can only do so much for a skill issue, after all.

Whether I'm whiling away the wee hours trying to improve my Katamari game, or simply lose track of time playing Paralives , the Light Mount TKL's luscious layers of sound-dampening foam and updated Silent switches continue to keep the secret of my late night gaming sessions.

items.title: [UPDATE] GTA 6 Leaker Releases Game Store, Nightclub and Beach Gameplay Videos, Defends Crypto Scheme
items.summary: The GTA 6 leaks have continued, this time with two new gameplay videos and a message from the leaker defending

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/vintage-vice-city-pack-exclusive-looks-01-1787655039708.jpg

UPDATE: CyberLeek has dropped a third GTA 6 leak video today following on fast from this morning's early releases featuring a nightclub and a beach scene — marking a significant escalation in the amount of footage hitting the internet.

This latest release of leaked material also continues to push CyberLeek's supposed agenda behind the leaks: an apparent dislike of the fact that physical media is being abandoned. "People are confused," reads the latest message watermarked into the footage. "This is not about actual discs. It is about ownership. Resale rights still matter — even in a digital-only era."

Fittingly, this message is overlaid on gameplay that shows GTA 6 protagonist Jason exploring a video game store, complete with spoof consoles (that look a lot like PS5) and game cases (I wonder if they include the discs!) There's even a sign in the store advertising "ex-rental games and movies for sale." Titles on offer in the fictional shop include games such as Glory Souls 2, Desolate Rim, We Came Together.
The leaks certainly appear to be ramping up ahead of Netflix's official GTA 6 reveal ( check out the global release times here ).
UPDATE: Hot on the heels of the nightclub gameplay leak, CyberLeek has released a 13th video, this time showing off Jason cycling on a beach packed with NPCs.
This new video includes the same watermarked memecoin advertisement and crypto statement detailed in the original story, below.
ORIGINAL STORY: The GTA 6 leaks have continued, this time with a new gameplay video and a message from the leaker defending their crypto scheme.

This 12th video leak shows relatively unremarkable nightclub gameplay, and includes the now standard advertisement of the 'CyberLeek' token at the heart of the cryptocurrency scheme that is believed to be the motivating factor behind all this.

But this new video also includes a watermarked message that defends the crypto scheme. “Stop the hate,” the message reads. “Channel that energy into protests. Not at those actually fighting for you. CL is taking huge risks in this battle. Leeks are free and donations cover operational costs. Using crypto is the only way. CL can’t win alone. Today is the day to show support and protest.”

CyberLeek has launched paid-for polls with a number of gameplay video choices people can vote on by sending tokens. People have spent hundreds of dollars' worth of the tokens to vote . This crypto scheme is ostensibly about protesting our all-digital future and Rockstar’s decision not to sell GTA 6 on-disc. At least one person showed up at Rockstar North in Scotland, filming themselves eating a leek outside the office.

There is growing concern that CyberLeek will release damaging story spoilers, with one poll option a prologue featuring Lucia. So far, the leaked gameplay videos have shown dual protagonist Jason only.

CyberLeek has continued to release GTA 6 gameplay videos for eight days straight despite Take-Two's subpoenas of Microsoft, Discord, and X / Twitter as part of the company's hunt for identifying information. We are now just two days away from Netflix’s timed-exclusive GTA 6 reveal, which is set to show gameplay officially for the first time.

From a Take-Two and Rockstar perspective, significant damage is being done. According to Bloomberg , Rockstar still doesn’t know how these leaks happened, nor who is behind them. And while there are no plans to shift this week’s big Netflix reveal, Bloomberg reported that there is frustration and anger internally at recent events, with management sending morale-boosting emails to staff.

Former Rockstar Games technical director Obbe Vermeij, however, downplayed the damage caused by the leaks . Vermeij, who worked at Rockstar North from 1995 to 2009, took to social media to say the Hot Coffee scandal was much more damaging than these GTA 6 leaks.
Neither Take-Two nor Rockstar has issued a statement on the GTA 6 leaks. IGN has asked for comment.

content.v: http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-25/6a8d5c8414c42.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。
上周，我和许多人分别聊了聊，重新深刻地感受到编辑这份工作的重量。我的聊天对象往往会因为身份而给予我很大的信任，把自身的经历无保留地交给我。这常常使我感到责任重大，而沟通本身又实在有趣。从个人角度，这是一个“I人”摒弃所有内向套上装甲开始战斗的高光时刻；从内容角度，每个人心里最深层的故事往往都有着相当的厚度。
但当我想享受沟通的过程，又不愿意承受这样的责任时，怎么办呢？
我想起之前刷到的一条新闻：前段时间，米哈游旗下的产品《BSide：Olivia Lin》宣布正式停运，有不少玩家对林离的离开表示不舍。这对于AI陪伴产品而言，也算是一条值得关注的消息。
这件事给了我灵感——有了，我来“采访”AI吧！
当然，现阶段可能很难采访到林离了。然而，如果只是纯粹的AI，我又很难从它嘴里问出太多有价值的事情——这个事儿在Deepseek爆火那一年我就试过了，它们往往会把一切的话题导向熵增、量子力学与哲学。
那么，我或许需要给AI一些身份，让它“扮演”一位受访者，而我可以从这位“受访者”嘴里问出一些故事来。出于就近原则，我选择了豆包，并给它下达了指令：
“我们来做个采访练习，你设定好自己的身份、具体故事等细节，不用告诉我。而我将会以‘最近发生了什么事’为主题来采访你，不用每个话题都回应我，让我看看我们能聊出一些什么火花。”
在短暂的思考后，豆包同意了（它似乎也没有拒绝权）我的建议。在大约1小时的文字沟通后，我尝试以文字形式将具体信息整理出来。
（采访具体内容完全为AI虚构，基于现实逻辑有所润色，如有雷同，纯属巧合。）
■ 开旧物店的“林先生”
林先生是西关人，在附近的静源巷（虚构地名）开了一家旧物小店。他店里突然一下子同时来了不少老物件，这成为他最近工作的主轴。他收过的物品里，有台上世纪70年代的台式收音机，外壳掉漆了，但拧开还能出声；还有一整套铁皮玩具小兵，是一位爷爷送来的，说是他儿子小时候的藏品。更早之前，一个姑娘抱来了一箱子学生时代的相册和情书，说分手后看见心里堵得慌，暂且放在店里寄售。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-25/1566a8d46cf95692.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
与通常听到“旧物”就能联想到的“废品回收”不同，林先生的小店主要业务有两项：一是收购和寄存那些有着人文价值或值得纪念的老物件，凭眼光和市场盈利；二是收留一些原主舍不得丢、但又不想自己留着的物件，帮它们找个好人家，再中间抽成一部分。
比较有意思的是后者：在买家看中物件、想要付款前，林先生会和他说清楚，这些是别人暂时存放的，万一之后主人想要取回，他会协调按价归还。只有愿意接受这点的，才会成交。
之所以有这个规定，是因为收留这些物件本身属于一种折中。卖家既不想直接扔掉，抹消一段回忆；又不愿意天天放在家里，勾起一些不愿回想的记忆。而对于愿意接手的买家而言，他们更看重里面独一无二的气质和温度，没有很强的占有欲。如果是信件之类的私人物件，出于隐私保护，在店里会单独保密存放，不对外展示，也不主动推销。
他印象里确实存在卖出去之后又被原主协调归还过的物件。半年前，一位男生买走了前面提到的情书，大概过了两个月，寄存的女生说自己已经走出来了，希望把当年的回忆带回去。而男生也没有多说什么，他原本就只是觉得旧信件很有温柔的气质，并没有强留的想法，二话不说就还回去了。送还箱子之后，男生对林先生说：“我突然明白这些旧物从来不是商品，是别人暂时寄存的一段人生。”
林先生大学读的是工商管理专业，毕业后在超市做运营管理，一做就是6年，后来因照顾生病的外婆，加上对工作的厌倦，索性选择了辞职。后来外婆离世，他舍不得她留下的老物件，两年后选择开一家这样的小店，一方面是存放外婆的回忆，另一方面则是满足自己对旧物的兴趣。他对旧物的兴趣也源自外婆，他是留守儿童，从小在外婆身边耳濡目染。她是那种对用旧了的东西感情很深的人，往往囤了很多老物件舍不得丢。
小店约莫30平方米，只有他一个人。每月的硬性开销在5000元左右，他平时没什么花销，最大的兴趣就是修复老物件和长距离散步。小店平均每个月的净收入在5000到7000元，核心收入一是寄卖物品的抽成，他通常会从成交价格中抽取15%作为服务费；二是寄存物品的保管费用，小件物品十几元，大件的家具或相机等贵重物品几十元，按月收取。

在他印象里，卖过最贵的东西是一套完整的、上世纪六七十年代的原版连环画，卖了8000元，他抽取500元作为服务费。画是一位退休老画家送来的。老画家年轻时在美术社工作，这套作品耗费他半年时间，还附带当年出版社的录用通知。现在他的子女定居外地，家里没位置放，辗转不安，所以放在店里售卖。买家是一位收藏家，清楚作品的价值，当场就答应了。之后，收藏家将这些尘封十几年的作品重新装裱，保存，偶尔拿出来和同好交流。老画家觉得自己珍视的物件有了新的去处，遇到了需要它的人，反而释怀了不少。
林先生今年37岁，未婚，前一任女友还是在超市工作时谈的，当时过于醉心工作，忽略了女友的感受，不想竟成了遗憾，至今没有新的缘分，他对此也已经淡然。他的父亲去世，只和母亲相依为命。每到周末，他会坐两站巴士，回到母亲家和她一起吃顿饭。关于人生，他似乎已经没有了升职、暴富、出名之类的世俗追求，只想尽可能地维持住自己的小店，过上自洽的低物欲生活。
“如果以后年岁渐长，租金压力变大，就缩小店面、精简货品，哪怕收入再降，也依旧守着这份慢节奏；实在难以支撑，便收掉店铺，只在家做旧物修复、整理文史资料，依旧守着这份安静的爱好度日。”他说，“我的追求概括起来就一句话：留住细碎温柔的时光，守住内心不浮躁的安稳，好好善待身边人和每一段普通人的回忆。”
■ 被稳稳地接住
在和“林先生”对话时，一方面，我惊叹于他能够接住所有的问题，且始终维持在一个相对自洽的逻辑循环里，让我一度快要相信真的有这么一间小店；另一方面，他也和所有AI一样，太过于能够“接住”我了，以至于一部分回答要么过于煽情（比如寄卖老物件的模式）、要么容易拐到类似市场调研的长篇大论（比如CCD相机涨价的核心逻辑，分一二三点说清），让人不免出戏。
这种情况刚出现时，我还会假模假样地问他“我注意到您对CCD的研究很深”“我注意到您说话非常有条理，逻辑清晰，就像AI一样”，这时，“林先生”反而会更加进入状态，回复我说：“这话倒是第一次有人这么说，倒也不奇怪，其实是两段经历磨出来的习惯。”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-25/1446a8d46cf40edf.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
聊到最后，我还问他，是否能够为我推荐更多的受访者，没想到他一下子丢出了好几个备选项出来。虽然看起来标签明显、略带刻意，但“林先生”无疑是我遇到过的最毫无保留的受访者。一切都是恰到好处的完美，除了豆包可能仍需再精进一下搜索功能。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-25/1296a8d46cf35cfd.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

items.title: 中场过后，小游戏的下一道门槛在哪里
